techniques.evidence: app/(studio)/_shell/nav.ts:47 One closed SECTIONS registry with stable ids; the current section is derived from the pathname by longest prefix, and the header, the agent tools and the kit all read it. Board overlays and section sub-addresses (?lane=, ?cal=) are not declared in the registry. They are spelled in links.ts and agentNav.ts instead, a coverage gap the technique calls debt.
app/(studio)/_shell/HeaderBar.tsx:52 One flat level, grouped by separators that are not destinations. There is no shell sub-nav and no third level, and the header has no collapse posture to persist.

app/(studio)/_shell/HeaderBar.tsx:57 Prefetch on intent is turned off deliberately: the comment says the Floor walks every v1 store. But a hover never warms a section, which the technique asks for. The frame itself holds still because the layout persists.

app/(studio)/_shell/Providers.tsx:85 Residents are listed in one header comment, and each one names its reaper. The cookie-renewal worker returns its unsubscribe and reports failure through the always-mounted toast region (line 119), so it does not die silently. Sign-out does a full load as the session-end reaper.

app/(studio)/_shell/headerFacts.ts:71 Nav entries carry no badge, so the steady state is quiet; the ledger +N newness badge and its seen-mark were removed (keys.ts:271). app/(studio)/_shell/nav.ts:23 The registry declares no tiers, roles or flags: this is a single-operator studio. `built` marks an unbuilt section, which is honestly temporary-disabled and not a lock. The one access gate is the layout's principal() (the studio-routes context).
app/(studio)/_shell/HeaderBar.tsx:49 The shell is a header bar with no sidebar slot. Screens that need a column (e.g. /kit) draw their own inside the page.

pairs.registryProposal: lazy-section-loading's prefetch-on-intent assumes warming a section costs only code. In a server-rendered router a prefetch can run the section's data loader too (here, a walk of every v1 store). The technique could name 'warm code without running the loader' as the target, and treat full-loader prefetch as the competing-cost case.

techniques.evidence: app/(studio)/layout.tsx:59 The failure should occupy only the section's territory while the frame and nav stay alive. With the nearest boundary at app/error.tsx, above this layout, the nav goes down with the section.
